1.web: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
1.asv: And Benjamin begat Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

2.web: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
2.asv: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

3.web: Bela had sons: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
3.asv: And Bela had sons: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

4.web: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
4.asv: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

5.web: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
5.asv: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

6.web: These are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, and they carried them captive to Manahath:
6.asv: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Geba, and they carried them captive to Manahath:

7.web: and Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera, he carried them captive: and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
7.asv: and Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera, he carried them captive; and he begat Uzza and Ahihud.

8.web: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
8.asv: And Shaharaim begat children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

9.web: He became the father of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcam,
9.asv: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcam,

10.web: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.
10.asv: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ houses.

11.web: Of Hushim he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
11.asv: And of Hushim he begat Abitub and Elpaal.

12.web: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;
12.asv: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with the towns thereof;

13.web: and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;
13.asv: and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

15.web: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,
15.asv: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,

16.web: and Michael, and Ishpah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah,
16.asv: and Michael, and Ishpah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah,

17.web: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hizki, and Heber,
17.asv: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hizki, and Heber,

18.web: and Ishmerai, and Izliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,
18.asv: and Ishmerai, and Izliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

19.web: and Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
19.asv: and Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

20.web: and Elienai, and Zillethai, and Eliel,
20.asv: and Elienai, and Zillethai, and Eliel,

21.web: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,
21.asv: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

22.web: and Ishpan, and Eber, and Eliel,
22.asv: and Ishpan, and Eber, and Eliel,

23.web: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
23.asv: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

24.web: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Anthothijah,
24.asv: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Anthothijah,

25.web: and Iphdeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak,
25.asv: and Iphdeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

26.web: and Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
26.asv: and Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

27.web: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
27.asv: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

28.web: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men: these lived in Jerusalem.
28.asv: These were heads of fathers’ houses throughout their generations, chief men: these dwelt in Jerusalem.

29.web: In Gibeon there lived the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah;
29.asv: And in Gibeon there dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife’s name was Maacah;

30.web: and his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
30.asv: and his first-born son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

31.web: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.
31.asv: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.

32.web: Mikloth became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their brothers in Jerusalem, over against their brothers.
32.asv: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And they also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against their brethren.

33.web: Ner became the father of Kish; and Kish became the father of Saul; and Saul became the father of Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
33.asv: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

34.web: The son of Jonathan was Merib Baal; and Merib Baal became the father of Micah.
34.asv: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.

35.web: The sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
35.asv: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

36.web: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri became the father of Moza.
36.asv: And Ahaz begat Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza.

37.web: Moza became the father of Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
37.asv: And Moza begat Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

38.web: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
38.asv: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

39.web: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
39.asv: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his first-born, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

40.web: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
40.asv: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
